decisions.target_truth: Center baggage=luggage for travel. Add high-value figurative emotional/cultural baggage=past experiences, assumptions, or burdens carried into a situation. Downgrade military baggage/equipment to recognition.

Center legal bail as noun money/security and verb release/provide bail. Preserve modern bail sb/sth out=rescue/help, especially financially, as a high-value construction. Downgrade scoop-water/bailer senses. Clarify phrase ownership so legal bail out and rescue bail out do not compete under mismatched noun/verb objects.

Restore literal noun bait=food/object used to lure fish/animals as L1. Preserve figurative bait=enticement and verb/construction bait sb into doing=lure/provoke into an action. Keep archaic dog-baiting/other peripheral verb uses only at low recognition.

Keep bake=cook with dry heat/oven as the main verb. Restore the familiar extended use bake/be baking in heat or sun=become/be extremely hot as a lower independent branch rather than merging it into the cooking sense while leaving it only in Core. Keep noun bake low.

Keep equilibrium, financial balance, balance/steady, weigh competing considerations, and settle accounts, plus on balance and strike/find a balance. Remove the duplicate secondary_sense for weighing pros and cons because that meaning is already Active.
Keep building balcony and theater/auditorium balcony; both are ordinary distinct uses.

Keep bald=hairless and bald=bare/lacking normal natural covering as main branches. Restore or retain figurative bald statement/assertion/fact=plain, blunt, bare of ornament/detail as low recognition if it remains named in Core; do not leave a deprecated meaning inside the learner center.

Broaden the primary noun to a round/spherical object or compact rounded mass, including sports balls and a ball of paper/wool/etc. Keep formal dance ball as a separate noun. Keep verb form into a ball at lower priority.
Center ballet as the dance/art form and allow reference to a ballet work/performance. Treat ballet music as related music/collocation rather than a competing main lexical sense.

Define noun balloon broadly as an inflatable flexible bag/envelope filled with air or gas, covering toy and larger gas/hot-air/weather balloons by application. Keep figurative verb balloon=expand/increase rapidly as high-value; travel by balloon lower.

Keep noun ballot as ballot paper/vote or voting method/process where context requires, and restore verb ballot=vote/decide or select by ballot as a separate POS branch. Do not merge verb voting senses into the noun ballot-paper sense.
Keep verb ban=officially prohibit and noun ban=official prohibition; current two-branch map is accurate and compact.
Single ordinary fruit noun is correct and sufficient.

Keep band=musical group, strip/band, and frequency band. Add or preserve ordinary band=group of people where learner-worthy. Own band together=unite/form a group under a grouping/unite verb extension or construction, not under verb tie/mark with a strip.
Keep noun bandage and verb bandage/wrap an injury; current owner is coherent.

Keep loud bang noun, bang/hit verb, and informal adverb bang=exactly/directly/abruptly where useful. Represent the American hair sense as usually plural bangs. Remove deprecated 'swift release of affective force' from Core/Word Feel.

Retain financial bank, river bank, bank/pile, bank/row and bank/reserve noun branches. Add common financial verb bank money / bank with an institution, and high-value construction bank on=depend/rely/count on; a basic familiar word must not remain noun-only.

Keep adjective bankrupt=financially unable to pay debts, noun bankrupt=legally insolvent person, and verb bankrupt=make financially insolvent. Figurative morally/intellectually bankrupt may be considered later but is not required to correct current Truth.

Keep noun banner=flag/large sign and under the banner of. Keep adjective banner=outstanding/especially successful, e.g. a banner year. Remove the duplicate a banner year collocation from the noun sense because it belongs to the adjective branch.
Single ordinary noun banquet=formal/ceremonial large meal is correct and sufficiently represented.

notes: Truth-stage artifact only: no Word or Relation semantics were mutated.
This closes the 201-400 Truth batch with no unresolved SOURCE_CHECK cases.
